findings.highlight: when they find someone that breaks one of Caster’s “three rules”

findings.governingReading: if they break one of Caster’s three rules or encounter someone who does
findings.explanation: The English omits that the implanted person can activate the command by violating a rule themselves.

findings.highlight: this thing that executes this one command

findings.highlight: a formal tool just to support her magic
findings.governingReading: a limited-purpose Mystic Code for supporting magecraft
findings.explanation: A Fate-specific technical fate for captured Shirou is mistranslated into an undefined “formal tool.”
